**English** · [Français](#français)

Portable builds: unzip / untar anywhere and run. `ffmpeg` is not included in the archives (see the README: the program downloads it on Windows and Linux, SHA-256 checked; on macOS install it with Homebrew or place it next to the app). For Windows there is also an optional installer that includes `ffmpeg.exe`.

| System | Archive |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-win64.zip` |
| Linux x86-64 | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| Linux ARM64 | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-macos-universal.zip` |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit), installer, ffmpeg included, not code-signed | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-win64-setup.exe` |

SHA-256 sums: `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Documentation: [README](https://github.com/ap3demak-rgb/ShaderToMP4#readme) · Website: https://ap3demak-rgb.github.io/ShaderToMP4
